arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

Chief Justice Rehnquist closed the argument.

paragraphs: Kansas requires sex offenders to join a treatment program. Refusal strips inmates of visitation and work rights. The state claims this protects safety. Inmates argue this violates their rights.
